RoselineMCP
Table of Contents

Installation

This guide will help you install and set up RoselineMCP on your system.

Prerequisites

Before installing RoselineMCP, ensure you have the following:

  • .NET 9.0 SDK or later (Download)
  • MSBuild (included with Visual Studio or .NET SDK)
  • Git (optional, for cloning the repository)
  • Docker (optional, for container deployment)

Installation Methods

Method 1: Build from Source

Clone and build RoselineMCP from source:

# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/phmatray/RoselineMCP.git
cd RoselineMCP

# Restore dependencies
dotnet restore

# Build the project
dotnet build -c Release

# Run the application
dotnet run --project RoselineMCP/RoselineMCP.csproj

Method 2: Docker Container

Pull and run the pre-built Docker image:

# Pull the latest image
docker pull phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest

# Run the container
docker run --rm -it phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest

For specific architectures:

# For x64/AMD64
docker pull phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest --platform linux/amd64

# For ARM64
docker pull phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest --platform linux/arm64

Method 3: Direct Integration with Claude Desktop

Add RoselineMCP to your Claude Desktop configuration:

  1. Locate your Claude Desktop configuration file:

    • macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
    • Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json
    • Linux: ~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json

  2. Edit the configuration file and add:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "roseline": {
      "command": "dotnet",
      "args": [
        "run",
        "--project",
        "/path/to/RoselineMCP/RoselineMCP/RoselineMCP.csproj"
      ]
    }
  }
}
  1. Restart Claude Desktop

Verify Installation

To verify RoselineMCP is installed correctly:

For Command Line

# Navigate to the project directory
cd RoselineMCP

# Run tests
dotnet test

# Check the build
dotnet build --version-suffix test

For Docker

# Check Docker image
docker images phmatray/roseline-mcp

# Test run
docker run --rm phmatray/roseline-mcp:latest --help

Platform-Specific Notes

Windows

On Windows, you may need to:

  • Enable long path support for deep project structures
  • Run as Administrator for certain MSBuild operations
  • Install Visual Studio Build Tools if not using full Visual Studio

macOS

On macOS with Apple Silicon (M1/M2):

  • The ARM64 Docker image provides native performance
  • Rosetta 2 can run x64 images if needed

Linux

On Linux distributions:

  • Install .NET SDK from Microsoft's package repository
  • May need to install additional MSBuild dependencies
  • Ensure Docker daemon is running for container deployment

Troubleshooting

Common Issues

Issue: MSBuild not found

# Solution: Install MSBuild locator
dotnet tool install -g dotnet-msbuild

Issue: NuGet restore fails

# Solution: Clear NuGet cache
dotnet nuget locals all --clear
dotnet restore

Issue: Docker permission denied

# Solution: Add user to docker group (Linux)
sudo usermod -aG docker $USER
# Log out and back in for changes to take effect
